modeD.label: FMVSS 108 lower beam LB2V (2-lamp, visual aim VOL)
modeD.source: 49 CFR 571.108 (FMVSS 108, 10-1-23 ed.): Table XIX-a LB2V (min/max columns), S10.18.9 (VOL cut-off at 0.4° D, gradient ≥ 0.13, inclination ±0.2°), S14.2.5.3 (≥ 18.3 m), S14.2.5.7.2.1 (sensor), S14.2.5.5 (¼° reaim at any test point). Lines "to L / to R" taken to 20°; the 10U–90U boundary checked over 10–12° U × ±20°.

items.name: 10U–90U boundary
items.note: regulation: 10° U–90° U, 90° L–90° R; checked 10–12° U × ±20° here

items.name: Cut-off gradient
items.note: G = log E(a) − log E(a + 0.1°) at 2.5° L, scanned 1.5° U–1.5° D of the preliminary aim; G ≥ 0.13

items.name: Cut-off inclination
items.note: S10.18.9.1.4: the maximum gradient 1° either side within ±0.2° of the one at 2.5° L
